The English [commentary](/en/blog/posts/2024-03-06-52111207/) published earlier this year has been included in a book: Concurrences' *Competition Law Dictionary*.

My entry, "distribution agreement," introduces vertical restraints with a focus on the application of the EU's VBER and U.S. case law, and, brief as it is, I also did my best to introduce Japanese law.

I would be glad if you picked it up.

> **[Competition Law Dictionary - Concurrences](https://www.concurrences.com/en/all-books/competition-law-dictionary)**
